note: Every top-level area of the emphire declares what it is for, which role owns it, and which pipeline stage writes into it. pipeline.py map reports anything in the tree that is not declared here, so nothing can hide and nothing new can be added without a stated purpose.

stages.S0: boot: read the rules before writing anything
stages.S1: intake: an opportunity, brief or thread arrives
stages.S2: read: the person, the context, the constraints
stages.S4: gate: the automatable rules are enforced
stages.S5: verify: facts, hashes, runs, claims checked
stages.S6: deliver: the owner sends, the delivery is journalled
stages.S7: log: session log and index updated
stages.S8: review: weekly, against the money and relationship rows

roles.content: THE CONTENT CREATOR, posts and articles
roles.engagement: THE ENGAGEMENT SPECIALIST, comments and replies
roles.opportunities: THE OPPORTUNITIES MANAGER, jobs, gigs, leads
roles.empire: THE EMPIRE BUILDER, clients, reviews, money
roles.visual: THE VISUAL DESIGNER, cards, covers, briefs
